answer_1.quote: To reflect real-world use cases, we focus on tasks commonly used in data generation and processing, such as rewriting, proofreading, translation, and style transfer for instruction tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include translated text, rewritten text, proofread text, and style-transferred text, depending on the instruction task.

answer_2.quote: In addition to LLM evaluation, we further support the results by conducting a length-difference-based automatic evaluation on the question answering task.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as the judge LLM to evaluate whether the outputs generated by each model adhere to the given instructions.
